title: Nawāqid-ul-Islām (Nullifiers of Islam)
description: Study the ten nullifiers of Islam (نواقض الإسلام) - actions that take a person out of the fold of Islam. This course covers the text and explanation of this important treatise by Imam Muhammad ibn Abdul-Wahhab, with lessons from the Salafi Arabic Reading Program.
short_description: Study the ten nullifiers of Islam that take a person out of the fold

modules.title: Text of Nawāqid-ul-Islām
modules.description: Reading and understanding the original Arabic text of Nawāqid-ul-Islām

lessons.title: Lesson 1 - Introduction & First Nullifier
lessons.content: Introduction to Nawāqid-ul-Islām and the first nullifier: Shirk (الشرك بالله)

lessons.title: Lesson 2 - Second & Third Nullifiers
lessons.content: The second nullifier: Killing a soul and the third nullifier: Sorcery (السحر)

lessons.title: Lesson 3 - Fourth & Fifth Nullifiers
lessons.content: The fourth nullifier: Aiding disbelievers and the fifth nullifier: Disbelieving in Qadr

modules.title: Explanation of Nawāqid-ul-Islām
modules.description: Detailed explanation of the ten nullifiers by Shaykh Abdul-Muhsin al-Qasim

lessons.title: Explanation Lesson 13
lessons.content: Detailed explanation of the nullifiers with evidences from Quran and Sunnah

lessons.title: Explanation Lesson 14
lessons.content: Continuation of the explanation with scholarly commentary

lessons.title: Explanation Lesson 15
lessons.content: Further explanation of important points and practical applications
